messages:
Noah: Quick sync  2m  I'm opening a narrow proposal for the deprecation + migration playbook we need to land before Q3 planning. Main goals: protect high-usage tenants, make migrations low-friction, and codify severity-driven timelines. Draft doc: https://rwd.internal/p/catalog/deprecations-playbook (WIP). Thoughts?

Reena: Love this. Can you summarize the severity levels? Customers ask for clarity (urgent vs standard deprecations).

Noah: Sure, draft severity matrix: S1 = security/critical correctness (48h notice + immediate soft-fallback), S2 = performance/regression (30-60d migration runway + migration assist), S3 = housekeeping/cleanup (90d default + incentives). I added a quick table in the doc.

Omar: For S2/S3 we need a concrete migration-assist flow. Propose: auto-export customer prompts -> run diffs against new model -> surface top-10 failing prompts -> offer migration concierge (one-time 4hr ses for enterprise). CLI sketch: ```rwd-migrate export --tenant T123 --since 2025-10-01 > tenant_prompts.json
rwd-migrate diff --base old-model --new new-model --input tenant_prompts.json --report report.html```

Katie: +1 on migration-cli. Also propose a short-lived dual-serve window: keep old model serving only for pinned tenants behind a flag for up to 30 days post-cut (no new onboarding to old model). That buys time for fixes. We should price it: free for 30d for impacted tenants, paid extension thereafter.

Reena: We need telemetry invariants to trigger auto-fallbacks during cut: latency p95 increase >20% or eval-quality drop >5% or error-rate >1% absolute. If any trigger fires, rollout pauses and ops is paged. Also require a manual override path.

Deploy-bot: Created ticket DEPREC-411: "deprecation-playbook + rwd-migrate CLI" assigned to omar, due 2 weeks.

Omar: I'll own the CLI and the report generation. Need an acceptance contract for the report format (top-10 diffs, token breakdown, sample prompts). Reena can own the eval thresholds.

Noah: On comms: propose staged customer notices: initial notice (deprecation rationale + timeline), 45/21/7 reminders, migration readiness check at 14 days. For S1 we send immediate eyes-on notices and we route to assigned SE/CS rep.

Katie: Also suggest a "migration health dashboard" tile in Console with per-tenant migration status, failing prompt examples, and estimated effort. That'll help AE/CS prioritize.

Reena: I'll add the acceptance bench minimal set for the playbook: hosted p95 latency, core-quality evals (core-kitchen + customer-critical), embedding-shape check for embed changes. Example in the doc: ```bench_min:
- latency_p95_ms: <= 240
- quality_delta_pct: >= -5
- embed_shape_unchanged: true (if manifests differ block auto-migrate)```

Omar: Regarding pin TTL: default pin life = 90d. For S2 we can extend pinned-serving for impacted tenants 30d automatically; for enterprise we support paid 6/12 month pin extensions via SOW. Need legal template.

Katie: I'll coordinate with Sales/Legal on a pin-extension SOW skeleton and migration-concierge pricing.

Noah: Owners summary: Noah (product) finalize playbook + comm templates, Omar (eng) build rwd-migrate + reports, Reena (eval) bench thresholds and acceptance scripts, Katie (CS/sales) SOW + dashboard UI spec. Meeting Thu 11 to lock.

Reena: I'll prototype the acceptance script and a sample report by Wed.

Omar: I'll sketch the CLI and wire up a basic report generator by Tue.

Noah: If no objections I'll merge the playbook Friday and include the initiative in the Q3 roadmap. Ping me if you want the doc rights to edit. Thanks all.
